heading: Shareable Campaign  Pages
content: Mobile-first pages with your story, photo, live progress bar, and a simple donate button.

heading: One-Tap Push Requests
content: Managers request donations directly from donors who've already said yes.

heading: Donor Pool (CRM)
content: Track supporters, their consent status, and their giving history in one place.

heading: Real Receipts & Updates
content: Every donor gets an instant receipt and a progress update after they give.

heading: Full Transparency
content: Public goal, service fee, and remaining balance are always visible — no hidden math.

heading: Built-In Security
content: Changia never sees or stores your mobile-money PIN. Every transaction is verified before it counts.
